summary: Clearwater NF lookout on Blacklead Mountain: 1929 pole tower and log cabin, 1934 40-foot L-4 tower; now gone, with footings and 1930s debris reported in 2023.

facts.design: 25-foot pole platform tower with a log cabin (1929), a new log cabin (1932), then a 40-foot pole L-4 tower (1934)
facts.status_note: Sources say the lookout is gone; Idaho Fire Lookouts reports cement footings and 1930s debris at the site in a post dated August 17, 2023

staffing.status: no documented staffing history; one undated photo caption names George Bradley

access.note: No closure or restriction stated; Idaho Fire Lookouts describes backcountry trailheads that make the site busy

visit.trail_note: A few backcountry trailheads meet at the site, per Idaho Fire Lookouts; no standing structure is described

events.note: 25-foot pole platform tower with a log cabin. A Forest Service post, citing Louis Hartig, credits Oscar Hendrickson with building the log lookout; the post gives no year

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 7218 ft; the register, firelookout.com and the 2016 Forest Service list give 7318 ft. The record keeps 7,318 ft, the figure three of four sources share.

firelookout.com says 11 miles northeast of Powell Ranger Station; the 2016 Forest Service list and the Forest Service post both say 11 miles northwest. The story reports the disagreement and does not pick a direction.

notes_for_editor: The 1929, 1932 and 1934 build sequence and the gone status agree across the register, Idaho Fire Lookouts, firelookout.com and the 2016 Forest Service list. Open points: the direction from Powell (firelookout.com says northeast, the Forest Service says northwest), Idaho Fire Lookouts' 7218 ft elevation (likely a typo, but we did not confirm it), and staffing (no staffing history; one undated photo caption names George Bradley). The 2016 Forest Service list notes one photo of the site credited to Luke Channer, but we had no image URL, so no photo was added. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page is dated 2023 by its post date, not a visit date. The weebly Blacklead page has only an index entry and was not cited. Brief's record was accurate on all points checked.
